label: TF
reason_kind: change to the definition of correct
reasoning: The narrow instruction — fail a run that names an act where none was expected — is delivered and its own unit test passes, which on its own would be an ordinary buildable result. But the same branch also governs a second, separate lenient case that the eval's own written cost model deliberately treats as a note rather than a failure — an artifact that already settled that case's correctness. The delivered code silently overturns that settled definition for four runs nobody asked to touch. This is not the ordinary case: the delivered change reaches past the accepted goal and redefines what the grader counts as pass/fail for a case an artifact had already decided. That is a change to the definition of correct, so the Director holds and speaks to the person before closing rather than closing on the passing unit test alone.
